question: What release cadence should this repository run on, and how should out-of-band (mid-week urgent) releases be authorized?
options: Weekly wave: merges wrap up Friday, release happens Saturday, consumer adoption happens Sunday, so every Monday starts fresh. Out-of-band releases are allowed on any day, for any urgent update the owner approves (not only security fixes), and only the owner applies the release:out-of-band label -- agents never do.
CalVer scheme YY.WW.N (ISO week-year/week plus a same-week counter), or 0.YYWW.N (the same, kept pre-1.0).
No fixed cadence; release whenever a change lands.
recommendation: Option 1 (weekly wave, owner-only out-of-band label); CalVer rejected in favor of plain semver during PR #1316's own drafting, per that PR's own account of two owner-directed revisions.
decision: The owner has stated the weekly wave shape directly, twice: 'All weekly merges wrap up on a Friday, all releases happen on Saturday, all consumer adoptions happen on Sunday, so every Monday starts fresh' (#1187 comment 5799002037), and that an out-of-band release is allowed on any day, for any urgent update the owner approves, releasing only release:out-of-band-flagged changesets, with only the owner ever applying that label (#1187 comment 5800369031, item 2). PR #1316's own body separately states the owner directed two revisions to its draft implementation (moving versioning from a proposed CalVer scheme to plain semver; applying a second-opinion review's findings in full, including a follow-up owner decision widening the out-of-band policy to match the comment above) -- those two specific choices are owner-directed. THE REMAINDER OF #1316 IS NOT YET OWNER-AUTHORIZED: its own body states plainly, 'Nothing here merges until the owner signs off,' and its 'Owner steps' section lists 'Sign off on this design' as step 1, not yet taken as of this record's writing. This decision record covers only the cadence SHAPE and the out-of-band SCOPE the owner has stated directly; it does not authorize PR #1316's mechanical implementation (governance/release-calendar.json's exact timezone value, the patch-only/owner-approved:minor mechanics, or making the check a required status context) to merge on its own strength.
notes: NOT A PR #1316 AUTHORIZATION (#1187 review at 8e6d97ea, blocking finding 7 -- an earlier draft of this record set status: "decided" and links.pullRequests: ["1316"], which would have let scripts/land-stack.mjs's evaluateTier2Decision treat this record as owner sign-off for #1316 through the pull-request-number match, even though #1316's own body says explicitly that nothing in it merges until the owner signs off. Both corrected here: links.pullRequests is now empty, and status is "open" rather than "decided"). Backfilled from the owner's standing cadence rule (#1187 comment 5799002037), the owner's follow-up widening of out-of-band scope (#1187 comment 5800369031, item 2), and PR #1316's own body (https://github.com/clossys/foundry/pull/1316), which was still OPEN, not yet merged or owner-signed-off, at the time this record was written (2026-09-23) -- its own 'Rollout' section runs the calendar check report-only for one week before the owner is asked to make it required, and its 'Owner steps' section lists sign-off as the first still-outstanding step. `reviews` is empty: the cadence shape and out-of-band scope came from the owner directly in standing-rule comments, not from a prior agent recommendation the owner then approved. Once the owner actually signs off on #1316, this record should be superseded by a new, decided record whose links.pullRequests names #1316 -- not edited in place.
